name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Your posting says great journalism doesn't sell itself. That's the job I've done my whole career: taking something valuable that's hard to explain and turning it into materials and conversations that close. I've spent 15+ years on both sides of it, writing the proposals and pitch narratives and then being the person in the room using them.

I've written proposals and statements of work in every sales role since 2018. At Accelo I ranked top three in sales on a growing team while quota roughly doubled, and at Fetch & Funnel I closed about $130K in new agency business in under six months, and was part of the team that reached the finalist round with a major banking prospect. At Birdeye I pitched and onboarded reseller partners and built the messaging and training they used to sell to their own customers. At Solenzo I build reusable messaging frameworks and adapt one core story for different audiences, the same skill you need when one franchise has to land with an advertiser, a funder, and a member.

I'll be straightforward that I haven't worked in media or written donor and fundraising appeals; my experience is commercial. What carries over is knowing what makes a buyer say yes and writing toward it. I'd welcome a conversation about the revenue lines this role would support first.
